sentences.en: She's the earner.

sentences.en: Living the dream.

sentences.en: But throughout this, you know, Jean struggled with her weight.
sentences.zh: 但在这一切过程中，你知道的，琴一直在跟体重作斗争。

sentences.en: I was obese from a BMI perspective.
sentences.zh: 从身体质量指数（BMI）来看，我当时属于肥胖。

sentences.en: After she had her baby, she was heavy.
sentences.zh: 生完孩子后，她的体重增加了很多。

sentences.en: She hated it.
sentences.zh: 她讨厌这样。

sentences.en: She had postpartum depression.
sentences.zh: 她患上了产后抑郁症。

sentences.en: She could not lose the weight.
sentences.zh: 她怎么也瘦不下来。

sentences.en: She did not feel good about that.
sentences.zh: 她对此感觉很糟糕。

sentences.en: Her self-image, her sense of her body was not happy.
sentences.zh: 她的自我形象和对身体的感知让她很不快乐。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And she would say she's gained and lost 70 pounds multiple times in her life.
sentences.zh: 她会说，她这一生中曾多次体重增减达70磅。

sentences.en: And it just felt like an endless struggle to her.
sentences.zh: 对她来说，这就像是一场无休止的挣扎。

sentences.en: Did she tell you why she was having so much trouble keeping the weight off?
sentences.zh: 她有没有告诉你，为什么她保持体重会这么困难？

sentences.en: You know, she talked about food noise.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，她提到了“食物噪音”。

sentences.en: Yeah, food noise to me feels like a constant need to eat.
sentences.zh: 是的，对我来说，“食物噪音”就像是一种持续不断想吃东西的冲动。

sentences.en: I don't feel hungry.
sentences.zh: 我感觉不到饿。

sentences.en: I don't feel full, so I don't have those physiological triggers to know when to eat.
sentences.zh: 我也感觉不到饱，所以我没有那些生理上的信号来告诉我什么时候该吃东西。

sentences.en: And the feeling of self-loathing that she describes of not being able to control that.
sentences.zh: 她描述了那种无法控制体重的自我厌恶感。

sentences.en: Like it's a failure of will.
sentences.zh: 就像是意志力的失败。

sentences.en: And then being embarrassed about the food that I was eating.
sentences.zh: 然后对自已吃的东西感到尴尬。

sentences.en: So sneaking food, you know, when I was home by myself, having a pint of ice cream, because I could and I could hide it.
sentences.zh: 所以会偷偷吃东西，你知道的，当我独自在家时，会吃掉一品脱冰淇淋，因为我可以这么做并且能藏起来。

sentences.en: Eventually, this leads to health issues.
sentences.zh: 最终，这导致了健康问题。

sentences.en: I do have other chronic conditions that developed over time.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，我确实发展出了其他慢性病。

sentences.en: I had non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.
sentences.zh: 我患有非酒精性脂肪肝。

sentences.en: And she says to her doctor, how about one of these GLP-1 drugs?
sentences.zh: 她对医生说，试试这些GLP-1减肥药怎么样？

sentences.en: And he wrote the script.
sentences.zh: 于是医生给她开药了。

sentences.en: And can you just remind us, Lisa, how do these drugs actually work?
sentences.zh: 丽莎，你能提醒一下大家，这些药物到底是如何起作用的吗？

sentences.en: Well, they work by reducing your feeling of being hungry.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它们通过降低你的饥饿感来发挥作用。

sentences.en: And because of that, people lose a ton of weight really faSt.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，人们能以极快的速度减掉大量体重。

sentences.en: And people who have been dieting their whole lives and struggling with their weight are able to keep their weight off as long as they're on the drugs.
sentences.zh: 那些一辈子都在节食、与体重作斗争的人，只要一直在用药，就能保持体重不反弹。

sentences.en: And, you know, she starts losing a lot of weight really faSt.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，她开始以极快的速度瘦下来。

sentences.en: Their clothing.
sentences.zh: 他们的衣服。

sentences.en: Her clothing was starting to, you know, fit a lot looser.
sentences.zh: 她的衣服开始变得，你知道的，宽松多了。

sentences.en: You know, 10 pounds, 20 pounds.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，瘦了10磅、20磅。

sentences.en: She used to not wear jeans, for example, because she wouldn't be able to fit in them comfortably.
sentences.zh: 比方说，她以前不穿牛仔裤，因为穿起来不够舒服。

sentences.en: She was always wearing the leggings type of clothing.
sentences.zh: 她总是穿着紧身裤之类的衣服。

sentences.en: They both noticed it.
sentences.zh: 他们都注意到了这一点。

sentences.en: So she slowly transitioned from the yoga pants to the, you know, to the jeans.
sentences.zh: 于是她慢慢从瑜伽裤过渡到，你知道的，牛仔裤。

sentences.en: Not eating that much.
sentences.zh: 没吃那么多。

sentences.en: And I feel for the first time in my life like this may be it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这辈子头一次，这次可能真的成了。

sentences.en: Like I may be able to keep this weight off because I've addressed the food noise.
sentences.zh: 就像我可能终于能保持体重了，因为我解决了“食物噪音”的问题。

sentences.en: The food noise that had been tormenting her is gone.
sentences.zh: 一直折磨着她的“食物噪音”消失了。

sentences.en: She feels like it's like a miracle, really.
sentences.zh: 她觉得这简直像个奇迹。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So this is just a really dramatic, very quick shift.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常戏剧性、非常迅速的转变。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, she lost 60 pounds inside of eight months.
sentences.zh: 我是说，她在八个月内瘦了60磅。

sentences.en: And then, you know, she notices that like people start treating her differently.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，她注意到人们开始对她另眼相待了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So flying home on a trip, a work trip, and I was in the window seat.
sentences.zh: 有一次乘飞机回家，出差回来，我坐在靠窗的座位上。

sentences.en: She told me this story about she travels a lot for work, and she was on a flight home from Chicago, and she was sitting in the window seat.
sentences.zh: 她跟我讲过这个故事，她经常因公出差，当时她正坐着从芝加哥飞回家的航班，坐在靠窗的座位上。

sentences.en: And a guy sat in the middle seat and said, oh, I'm so glad I'm sitting next to a small person.
sentences.zh: 一个男的坐在中间座位上说，哦，我太高兴能挨着一个瘦子坐了。

sentences.en: You know, he said, you know, sometimes you're in the middle seat, and you're crowded between two big people, and it's really uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他说，有时候你坐在中间座位，被夹在两个胖子中间，真的超级难受。

sentences.en: And so on the one hand, I'm like, yay, I'm a small person.
sentences.zh: 所以一方面，我在想，太好了，我变瘦了。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, it really pissed off because when people looked at me before or sat next to me on the plane before,
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，我真的很生气，因为当以前的人看着我或者在飞机上挨着我坐的时候，

sentences.en: were they thinking these things the whole time where I'm trying to have a nice conversation and all that's in their head is I'm stuck next to this fat person?
sentences.zh: 他们一直在这样想吗？而我当时只是想好好聊聊天，结果他们满脑子想的都是“我怎么被卡在这个胖子旁边”？

sentences.en: She was so furious on behalf of her bigger self.
sentences.zh: 为她过去的那个胖胖的自己感到无比愤怒。

sentences.en: It's like in this moment, she's almost caught between her old self and her new self.
sentences.zh: 就好像在那一刻，她几乎被夹在了过去的自己和崭新的自己之间。

sentences.en: She's defending her old self as she's like happy for her new self.
sentences.zh: 她在为过去的自己打抱不平，同时又为崭新的自己感到高兴。

sentences.en: It's really an unbelievable moment of transformation.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个令人难以置信的蜕变时刻。

sentences.en: Well, and even at work.
sentences.zh: 嗯，甚至在工作上也是如此。

sentences.en: You know, at work, she felt this way.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在工作上她也有这种感觉。

sentences.en: She's a successful professional.
sentences.zh: 她是个成功的职场人。

sentences.en: She's always been a successful professional.
sentences.zh: 她一直都是个成功的职场人。

sentences.en: But I feel like the marketing team is putting me out there more.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得市场团队把我推到台前更多了。

sentences.en: Now, suddenly at work, she's getting these outward-facing opportunities where she's being put forward as a talking head to talk to the media, for example,
sentences.zh: 现在，她在工作上突然得到了这些面对公众的机会，比如被推到台前作为发言人接受媒体采访，

sentences.en: or she's being put forward to talk to the board in a way that she hadn't been before.
sentences.zh: 或者以一种她以前从未有过的方式被推到董事会面前进行汇报。

sentences.en: But I feel like there's this different perception of me.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得大家对我的看法变了。

sentences.en: I'm the same person.
sentences.zh: 我还是同一个人。

sentences.en: I'm just 60 pounds lighter.
sentences.zh: 我只是轻了60磅。

sentences.en: Now, this is a thing that others have said, too, about these drugs.
sentences.zh: 现在，这也是其他人对这些药物的评价。

sentences.en: That once the world starts, you know, approving of you, and I've got air quotes up here, the doors open.
sentences.zh: 一旦全世界开始，你知道的，对你表示认可——我在这里打个双引号——大门就敞开了。

sentences.en: And a lot of the people I talk to for this story talk about the opportunities that get presented to them, promotions and dates.
sentences.zh: 我在做这篇报道时采访的许多人，都谈到了摆在他们面前的新机遇，比如升职和约会。

sentences.en: You have access to partners that you didn't have access to before.
sentences.zh: 你可以接触到以前接触不到的伴侣。

sentences.en: And you can do things physically with your body that you couldn't do before.
sentences.zh: 而且你的身体可以做出以前做不到的物理动作。

sentences.en: I talked to one guy who started running marathons all of a sudden.
sentences.zh: 我采访过一个人，他突然开始跑马拉松了。

sentences.en: And if you're married, it presents a whole world of things that you have to suddenly start figuring out that may have been latent or unspoken.
sentences.zh: 如果你已经结婚了，这会带来一整套你必须突然开始摸索的问题，而这些问题以前可能是潜藏的或没有说出口的。

sentences.en: Or the agreement that you made when you got together has to be renegotiated in some way that you didn't anticipate at all.
sentences.zh: 或者你们在一起时达成的契约，现在必须以一种你完全意想不到的方式重新谈判。

sentences.en: And that was definitely true for Gene and Javier.
sentences.zh: 对于琴和哈维尔来说，情况确实如此。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们去去就回。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的填词游戏“连线”（Connections）。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽尔斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作“拼字蜂”（Spelling Bee）和“字母箱”（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“彩色听觉”的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到声音的这些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始游戏吧。

sentences.en: Lisa, I'm so curious how these huge changes that Gene is going through, both physically and emotionally, are affecting her relationship with Javier.
sentences.zh: 丽莎，我很好奇，琴正在经历的这些巨大变化——无论是身体上还是情感上的——是如何影响她和哈维尔的关系的？

sentences.en: I mean, one of the first things that happened was that she totally lost her appetite for alcohol.
sentences.zh: 我是说，最早发生的事情之一就是她对酒精的欲望彻底消失了。

sentences.en: And that's not unusual.
sentences.zh: 这并不罕见。

sentences.en: People on these medications frequently lose their appetite for alcohol, so much so that researchers are investigating whether GLP-1s are a good treatment for alcohol abuse,
sentences.zh: 服用这些药物的人经常会失去对酒精的渴望，以至于研究人员正在调查GLP-1是否是治疗酗酒、

sentences.en: addiction, other kinds of compulsive behaviors.
sentences.zh: 成瘾以及其他各类强迫行为的良药。

sentences.en: And for Gene, the loss of appetite just changed her whole approach to having fun with her husband.
sentences.zh: 对琴来说，食欲的消失彻底改变了她和丈夫享受乐趣的方式。

sentences.en: I mean, no longer could they sit on the couch and uncork a bottle of wine at the end of the day or go to the local brew pub and try out the new beer.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们再也不能像以前那样在一天结束时坐在沙发上开一瓶红酒，或者去当地的精酿啤酒馆尝试新啤酒了。

sentences.en: None of it felt good to her anymore.
sentences.zh: 她对这一切再也提不起兴趣了。

sentences.en: We go over to a friend's house and we'll have a game night or something like that.
sentences.zh: 我们去朋友家玩桌游之类的。

sentences.en: I mean, we'll still go.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们还是会去。

sentences.en: I just won't drink.
sentences.zh: 我只是不喝酒。

sentences.en: And that's fine.
sentences.zh: 这没问题。

sentences.en: But it was also just that her, like, appetite for that kind of life, where you're going out and you're hanging with friends and you're staying up late and everybody's drinking,
sentences.zh: 但问题还在于，她对那种生活方式的“胃口”，比如外出、和朋友闲逛、熬夜、每个人都在喝酒的生活，

sentences.en: those appetites, they had limits as well.
sentences.zh: 那种欲望也是有限度的。

sentences.en: I would have liked to get home earlier before anyway.
sentences.zh: 其实我本来就更想早点回家。

sentences.en: And now I can say, I'm not drinking.
sentences.zh: 现在我可以直说了：我戒酒了。

sentences.en: I would like to be home.
sentences.zh: 我想回家。

sentences.en: In fact,
sentences.zh: 事实上，

sentences.en: she had an introverted side that hadn't been able to express herself because she was so busy being a pleaser extrovert because she was in a bigger body and she wanted people to like her.
sentences.zh: 她其实有一面比较内向，以前一直无法表现出来，因为她太忙于做一个讨好型外向者了，因为她以前体型较胖，想让别人喜欢她。

sentences.en: I am not as much of a night owl as my husband is.
sentences.zh: 我可没有我丈夫那么是个夜猫子。

sentences.en: And I like to read my Kindle a little bit before I go to sleep at night.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢在晚上睡觉前用Kindle看一会儿书。

sentences.en: And I just don't do well the next day if I'm out really late.
sentences.zh: 如果我在外面待到很晚，第二天我的状态就会很差。

sentences.en: Once she was in a smaller body, she could assert herself and say, like, actually, I like being at home.
sentences.zh: 一旦她的体型变瘦了，她就能坚持自我，说出“其实我喜欢待在家裡”这样的话。

sentences.en: But she's also telling Javier she doesn't want to do the things that he thought that she loved.
sentences.zh: 但她同时也在告诉哈维尔，她不想做那些他以为她热爱的事情。

sentences.en: And that they love together.
sentences.zh: 以及他们曾经共同热爱的事情。

sentences.en: They love together, right.
sentences.zh: 他们共同热爱的事情，没错。

sentences.en: That was like the fabric of the fun that they had always had together.
sentences.zh: 那就像是他们俩一直以来共同拥有的快乐的基石。

sentences.en: How does he respond to all this?
sentences.zh: 面对这一切，他作何反应？

sentences.en: He does not like it.
sentences.zh: 他很不高兴。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: No, I like going with the flow.
sentences.zh: 不，我喜欢顺其自然。

sentences.en: I mean, living in a moment and enjoying, you know, whatever's going on in social aspects or social events.
sentences.zh: 我是说，活在当下，享受社交层面或社交活动中发生的一切。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He was like, no, this is not how we are.
sentences.zh: 他的态度是：不对，我们不是这样的人。

sentences.en: We are the people who do these things.
sentences.zh: 我们就是喜欢做这些事的人。

sentences.en: I think he misses his drinking buddy, the person who was going to stay out late.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他怀念他的酒友，那个愿意陪他熬夜的人。

sentences.en: It sounds like the lifestyle stuff led to a lot of tension.
sentences.zh: 听起来生活方式的改变引发了大量的紧张关系。

sentences.en: More than tension.
sentences.zh: 岂止是紧张。

sentences.en: I mean, I think they had a really, really, really hard time.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我觉得他们经历了一段非常、非常、非常艰难的时期。

sentences.en: And when I met them, they were fighting a lot.
sentences.zh: 当我遇到他们时，他们经常吵架。

sentences.en: Before it was a conversation and, you know, and now it's a fight and one of us is going to walk away angry because we're not seeing eye to eye on something.
sentences.zh: 以前那叫沟通，你知道的，而现在那叫吵架，而且总有一个人会气冲冲地走开，因为我们在某些事情上看法不一致。

sentences.en: And their fights could be loud and ugly.
sentences.zh: 他们的争吵可能会声音很大、很难看。

sentences.en: And this most recent time when I met them, I felt that they were bought into that agreement.
sentences.zh: 而最近这一次我见到他们时，我觉得他们真正认同并接受了那个约定。

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: And what about the physical stuff, I have to ask?

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: But they're still not having sex.
sentences.zh: 但他们还是没有发生性关系。

sentences.en: My reaction to that has been to be patient and to not be pushing it.
sentences.zh: 我对此的反应是保持耐心，不要去催促。

sentences.en: So there's not much more I can do.

sentences.en: I mean, other than to say it sucks.

sentences.en: And I miss that.

sentences.en: And I wonder if it'll ever come back.

sentences.en: Is there anything you want to say more?
sentences.zh: 你还有什么想说的吗？

sentences.en: I still feel very strongly that this is one of the best things that I've done for myself.
sentences.zh: 我仍然坚信这是我为自己做过的最好的事情之一。

sentences.en: This is it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: You know, I have lost the weight and I will maintain this for life.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我已经减掉了体重，而且我会终生保持下去。

sentences.en: And I'm just so grateful.
sentences.zh: 我真的非常感激。

sentences.en: Lisa, thank you so much.

sentences.en: It's such a pleasure to talk to you.
